title.zh: 【加密货币行业在本届美国中期选举中已投入约 1.76 亿美元】
title.en: 【加密货币行业在本届美国中期选举中已投入约 1.76 亿美元】

current_state.zh: 加密行业本轮美国中期选举支出约 1.76 亿美元，覆盖逾 100 场选举；Fairshake 及其附属组织支出约 1.508 亿美元，其他加密组织约 2500 万美元；Fairshake 支持的 58 名初选或特别选举候选人中 53 人获胜；众议院选举支持两党候选人，但在参议院选举中仅支持共和党候选人；俄亥俄州参议院选举支出超过 6800 万美元，重点针对 Sherrod Brown；《CLARITY 法案》在本届国会仍停滞。
current_state.en: The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this cycle; Fairshake and affiliates spent about $150.8 million, with other crypto groups about $25 million; 53 of Fairshake's 58 backed primary or special-election candidates won; it supports bipartisan House candidates but only Republicans in Senate races; Ohio Senate spending exceeded $68 million, targeting Sherrod Brown; the CLARITY Act remains stalled in this Congress.

updates.what_changed_zh: 本周期内，加密行业在100多场美国中期选举中投入约1.76亿美元，主要由Coinbase、Ripple和a16z支持的Fairshake超级政治行动委员会牵头，其支持的58名初选和特别选举候选人中有53人晋级，这是旨在争取监管明确性的长期两党策略的一部分。
updates.what_changed_en: The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this cycle, led by the Coinbase-, Ripple- and a16z-backed Fairshake super PAC, which has seen 53 of its 58 backed primary and special-election candidates advance as part of a long-term, bipartisan strategy to secure regulatory clarity.

updates.title_zh: 加密行业已投入约1.76亿美元支持美国中期选举盟友，为后特朗普时代布局
updates.title_en: 加密行业已投入约1.76亿美元支持美国中期选举盟友，为后特朗普时代布局
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：Fairshake 及其附属组织支出约 1.508 亿美元，其他加密组织约 2500 万美元；在参议院民主党阻止《CLARITY 法案》后，Fairshake 在参议院选举中仅支持共和党候选人；俄亥俄州参议院选举支出超过 6800 万美元，重点针对 Sherrod Brown。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: Fairshake and affiliates spent about $150.8 million, other crypto groups about $25 million; after Senate Democrats stalled the CLARITY Act, Fairshake shifted to backing only Republicans in Senate races; Ohio Senate spending exceeded $68 million, targeting Sherrod Brown.
updates.current_state_zh: 加密行业本轮美国中期选举支出约 1.76 亿美元，覆盖逾 100 场选举；Fairshake 及其附属组织支出约 1.508 亿美元，其他加密组织约 2500 万美元；Fairshake 支持的 58 名初选或特别选举候选人中 53 人获胜；众议院选举支持两党候选人，但在参议院选举中仅支持共和党候选人；俄亥俄州参议院选举支出超过 6800 万美元，重点针对 Sherrod Brown；《CLARITY 法案》在本届国会仍停滞。
updates.current_state_en: The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this cycle; Fairshake and affiliates spent about $150.8 million, with other crypto groups about $25 million; 53 of Fairshake's 58 backed primary or special-election candidates won; it supports bipartisan House candidates but only Republicans in Senate races; Ohio Senate spending exceeded $68 million, targeting Sherrod Brown; the CLARITY Act remains stalled in this Congress.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across over 100 US midterm elections, led by Fairshake's $150.8 million, to build bipartisan congressional allies and preserve legislative momentum after Trump, while shifting Senate support exclusively to Republicans after Democrats stalled the CLARITY Act.
